intent_contract.text: 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create this arm's independently selected, complex nocturnal botanical-forensics photograph with an unmistakably adult subject informed by the supplied image as an appearance reference, then test whether the arm-specific oval face-shape variation is visible. The reference supports general visible appearance only, never a biometric or same-identity claim, and the oval face contour target takes precedence over the reference contour.

Create a complex nocturnal botanical-forensics scene inside a moonlit orchid conservatory. An unmistakably adult forensic botanist reconstructs a luminous pollen-transfer path, aligning transparent measurement panels between rare blooms while numbered evidence dishes and a macro camera document the trace. Show an oval face shape through a gently elongated contour: temples and cheekbones of nearly balanced width, smoothly tapering sides without angular corners, a softly rounded jaw, and a rounded chin, with overall facial length modestly greater than width. Keep both facial sides fully visible, hair swept behind the temples and jaw, and use a neutral attentive expression. Frame a restrained frontal or slight three-quarter environmental portrait with distortion-controlled perspective and soft facial modeling light. The supplied image is an appearance reference for general adult appearance rather than identity evidence; the specified oval contour governs whenever it differs from the reference contour.
